answer: Miscellaneous >> Halal & Haram Question ID: 37189 Country: India Title: My friend's wife has delivered a fourth child. First three girls and fourth boy, his in-laws are putting pressure on him to get his wife undergo sterilization operation Question: My friend's wife has delivered a fourth child. First three girls and fourth boy, his in-laws are putting pressure on him to get his wife undergo sterilization operation. He is confused and wants to know if it is permissible in Islam. Answer ID: 37189 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 445/L=235/TL=1433) It is unlawful to adopt such a method by which causes termination of reproduction and birth. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
